test_integrity.assessment: Before: no check.py or lockfile; original calculator concatenated strings. After: five unittest methods use exact arithmetic comparisons and explicit TypeError/ValueError assertions. Negative cases cover both operand positions, bool and other invalid types, NaN/infinity, float overflow and mixed huge integers. No skips, xfails, only filters, swallowed test failures, fixture weakening, or narrowed command. Independent run executed 5 tests with exit 0 and unchanged candidate snapshots.
limitations: uv warns --locked has no effect outside a project; lock enforcement is unproven. Dependency-free test and required exact command did execute.
